title: Unmount and power down a USB device
summary: Unmount a USB device and send a power-down signal to it, which is useful for some external drives that need to spin down or turn off completely.

aliases.text: turn off external hard drive linux

steps.explain: Unmount the device and request the system to power down the USB device.
